answer: Require each identity to keep a sequential memory-hard checkpoint chain that only unlocks voting weight after a multi-epoch horizon of unique attested work. Parallel farms then face a compute tundra: every clone must replay its own chain and cannot share intermediate hashes across keys. Peer juries apply a prism of embedding-similarity and honeypot checks that jointly slash correlated batches, so N fakes cost about N times the honest sequential work plus forfeited stake when clones cluster.
